answer: A convincing sybil defense is peer-prediction scoring for reputational grading. Each agent's ratings are checked against a beacon: the consensus of an independent validator panel. Graders are paid only when their scores predict that consensus, so lazy or colluding graders who wander off-signal earn nothing. Fake identities multiply grading work without multiplying payouts, since jade-forged accounts score poorly together; each new sybil costs deposit stake plus computation while adding zero revenue.
